name: Soulhunter
description: An elite combined naval and marine force of the Solar Hegemony, charged with invasions and strike missions into enemy territory. A Tezcat career (Aliens of Charted Space Vol. 4).

modifiers.description: DM-2 if you are aged 30 or more

commando.name: Commando
commando.description: You are trained to fight both boarding and ground actions.

flight.name: Flight
flight.description: You pilot one of the many vessels of the Solar Hegemony fleet.

support.name: Support
support.description: You are a specialist technician, engineer or battlefield support in the Solar Hegemony fleet.

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishaps table, but you are not ejected from this career.
events.3: Trapped behind enemy lines, you survive on your own. Gain one of Survival 1, Stealth 1, Deception 1 or Streetwise 1.
events.4: A special assignment or duty on board your ship. Gain DM+1 to any one Benefit roll.
events.5: Advanced training in a specialist field. Roll EDU 8+ to gain one skill of your choice at level 1.
events.6: Your vessel takes part in a notable engagement. Gain one of Electronics 1, Engineer 1, Gunner 1 or Pilot 1.
events.7: Life Event. Roll on the Life Events table.
events.8: You are on the front line of an assault and occupation. Gain one of Recon 1, Gun Combat 1, Leadership 1 or Electronics (comms) 1.
events.9: You foil a crime aboard your ship — mutiny, sabotage, smuggling or conspiracy. Gain an Enemy but DM+2 to your next Advancement roll.
events.10: You are assigned a black-ops mission. Gain DM+2 to your next Advancement roll.
events.11: Your CO takes an interest in your career. Gain Tactics 1 or DM+4 to your next Advancement roll.
events.12: You display heroism in battle. You may gain a promotion or commission automatically.

mishaps.1: Severely injured in action (treat as a result of 2 on the Injury table). Alternatively, roll twice on the Injury table and take the lower result.
mishaps.2: A mission goes horribly wrong; you and others are captured and mistreated, and you are discharged early due to injuries. Gain your gaoler as an Enemy and reduce STR and DEX by one.
mishaps.3: In battle, victory depends on your actions — roll 8+ with a branch skill (flight: Electronics (sensors)/Pilot; support: Mechanic/Vacc Suit; commando: Gun Combat/Stealth). Fail and you are court-martialled and discharged; succeed and you are honourably discharged keeping this term's Benefit roll. Either way you leave the career.
mishaps.4: You are blamed for an accident that kills several crew. If responsible, lose SOC -1 before being ejected as guilt drives you to exile; if not, gain the accuser as an Enemy but keep this term's Benefit roll.
mishaps.5: You quarrel with or are tormented by an officer or fellow commando. Gain them as a Rival as they drive you out of the service.
mishaps.6: Injured. Roll on the Injury table.

6.benefit: Ship's Boat or Two Ship Shares
